format: Moraff's Revenge 3.3 town mechanics recovered from DUNSMALL.EXE
method: Static QB3 machine-code and initialized-MBF data-flow analysis; no DOS execution

entry_dispatch.prompt: There's a rope above. Hit U to climb it.
entry_dispatch.trigger: U at a listed floor-zero coordinate

inns.name: Flea Bag Inn
inns.healing: health_current += 1, clamped to health_max; DS:B558 bit 0 instead heals fully
inns.disease: after robbery, independently INT(RND*10)=1 (10%) sets disease to 1
inns.evidence: DUNSMALL 1E0A-1EDF; MBF doubles C156=10 and C15E=-10

inns.name: Yuppydom Inn
inns.healing: health_current += 3, clamped to health_max; DS:B558 bit 0 instead heals fully
inns.evidence: DUNSMALL 1F3D-1FBA; MBF doubles C228=200 and C230=-200

inns.name: Kings Inn
inns.evidence: DUNSMALL 1FCD-2041; MBF doubles C28C=6000 and C294=-6000

bank.on_entry: all carried_treasure is added to pocket_money, carried_treasure becomes zero, bag coin-content value becomes 0.5
bank.weight_after_exchange: 150 + equipped_armor*25, except DS:B558 bit 5 magic armor contributes zero armor weight
bank.transfer: digits only; withdrawal/deposit transfers MIN(requested, source balance), so an excessive request transfers the entire source balance

temple_charge_order: The fee is deducted before checking whether disease or poison is present; a no-effect cure is still charged.

store.wizard_restriction: class 2 may buy choice 1 (Knife), but cannot buy choices 2 through 7; the compiled test is selection > 1 AND class = 2 at 2974-29B6
store.town_offer: shown only when not already owned and pocket+bank > 99999, but purchase requires the full 1000000 in pocket

wizard_guild.charge_order: funds are checked before opening the nested P/B picker, but the applicable fee is deducted only after a nonzero selection
